description: The 4K isolation lab (owner, 24 Nov 2026 night: "we can keep sweeping but it sounds like this is an issue we could test much more specifically"): one path in one region, London, where the source and the contributor are. 7 dedicated-CPU instances, $0.648 an hour, two billed hours ($1.30): the source host lon-src, the contributor contrib-lon alone, the viewer host lon-view (g6-dedicated-4 each); the two first forwarders lon-dist-a (g6-dedicated-2, the size the mesh uses) and lon-dist-c4 (g6-dedicated-4); the edges lon-edge-1 (g6-dedicated-2) and lon-edge-c4 (g6-dedicated-4). The topology compiler's fixed first hop (src/relay_topology.rs, validate_merged_forwarders and the deploy's fast_plane_feed) lets the contributor feed exactly the two first forwarders of its site, every node below them needs a primary and a secondary parent, and an edge's parents are the first two distributors of its site by name (edge i of the site takes the first as its primary when i is even): a third forwarder (an autoscale slot) would be a lease child of the first two, one hop further down, so a second forwarder-and-edge pair on g6-dedicated-4 cannot be fed by the contributor beside lon-dist-a and lon-dist-b. The node-size pair is therefore the second ingress itself: lon-dist-c4 is the second first forwarder, lon-edge-c4 (rank 1) takes it as its primary and lon-dist-a as its secondary, lon-edge-1 (rank 0) the other way round. The driver (scripts/linode-4k-isolate.py) holds one edge out of service (standby_edges) and makes one forwarder carry no video by dropping the contributor's video class ports (23000-23999, the relay ports plus class_port_offset) at the other one's input with nftables, so the shapes are: one forwarder = contributor -> lon-dist-a -> lon-edge-1 (lon-dist-c4 gets no video; audio flows through both); two forwarders = the normal shape, lon-edge-1 fed in full by lon-dist-a and repair by lon-dist-c4 (the secondary is a 4-vCPU node here, which can only help it); node size = contributor -> lon-dist-c4 -> lon-edge-c4 (lon-dist-a gets no video). The `iso` block is read by the driver: the nodes of each shape. Generated by hand for the isolation test; run only by scripts/linode-4k-isolate.py, under the lab tool's watchdog and budget.
